patch.value: The shared script launcher skipped every gate it guarded when a path could not be resolved

isMainInvocation caught a realpathSync failure and returned false, which makes runIfMain treat a direct invocation as a library import and skip main, so a required release check exits zero having done nothing.

value.author: claude
value.text: The refactor into script-launcher.ts is why the fleet-wide sweep missed this repo. A survey that grepped scripts/docstring-gate.ts for realpathSync found nothing here, because the guard had moved into the shared launcher and the gate merely re-exports it. Factoring a defect out of the file people search makes it invisible to the search.

value.author: claude
value.text: Unlike the copies in other repositories this variant resolves both sides through realpathSync, deliberately, to normalise Windows drive-letter casing. That reasoning is sound and was kept. Only the catch was removed, so the fix does not reintroduce the casing bug the both-sides comparison exists to prevent.
